contract.correction: The digest and byte count bind the complete immutable Buffer transmitted to inner Node, including INPUT, transformed arithmetic and the revised entry.
contract.framing: A bounded READY frame precedes the unchanged canonical Clock witness. READY.ppid binds the timeout child; witness metadata.pid binds READY.pid. Stream and frame hashes stay separate.
contract.timing: Forty milliseconds of requested delays is nominal arithmetic only, not a completion or scheduling guarantee.

sourceMapping.method: Official HTTPS raw source at an immutable commit, with retained exact byte counts and SHA256; independently reviewed by an architecture auditor.
sourceMapping.conclusion: The reviewed JavaScript, fast and slow C++, libuv precise and Linux branches lead to CLOCK_MONOTONIC. PRECISE=0 and FAST=1 were confirmed from the defining header.
sourceMapping.backendFailureLimit: clock_gettime failure can return zero without a separate error flag. A zero prefix followed by positive readings may satisfy order and progress checks; the witness cannot prove a failure-free backend.

implementation.scope: Pure framing and witness adapter with synthetic inputs only. It returns CANDIDATE_ONLY and does not publish acceptance or mutate caller replay state.

evidence.architectureAudit: No blocker within the trusted-caller pure scope; its unbounded replay-copy note was corrected and independently verified.

implementation.correction: Replaced full replay-history copying with intrinsic membership lookup for the current challenge and a zero-or-one-element temporary Set.
implementation.limits: Trusted ordinary caller values and uncompromised built-ins are required. No complete result classifier, durable replay publication, native settlement, absence or authenticated outer acceptance is supplied.
implementation.next: Integrate the accepted local adapter and source generator into a separately reviewed N1 observer, then assembly, package and window tools.

evidence.architectureAudit: No blocker within fixed-profile local source and entry scope.

sourceGenerator.execution: FAKE_VM_ONLY; emitted entry never ran with a real process, clock or timer.
sourceGenerator.corrections: Bounded scalar strings and exact target versions before regex, JSON or allocation; separated a conservative field-width bound from a reachable integer example.
sourceGenerator.limit: Returned source Buffer is mutable. Transport must retain a private snapshot and revalidate hash/length before sending exactly those bytes. These inner bounds do not prove observer envelope, escaping, stderr, transport, native timing or RSS bounds.

gates: N1 outer transport exception remains proposed, not inferred from local adoption.
Fresh applicable health and admission are required for any future host window.
Complete observer/package closure, escaped receipt fit, native timing and settlement remain unproved.
RD7 and owner-approved limits, original S3 capture, owner-present S3 and separate rollback authority remain gated.

observerArchitecture.placement: The remote observer certifies lifecycle and retained bytes only. CAPTURE_OBSERVED carries DEFERRED_LOCAL witness validation and NOT_EVALUATED Clock semantics. Final local Clock review requires authenticated complete outer evidence, R1b semantics and all publication gates.
observerArchitecture.schemas: Every future package, runner, envelope, finalizer, adapter and window layer must require exact new N1 schemas. Legacy B2 success aliases and NORMAL case translation are forbidden.
observerArchitecture.failureRule: UNKNOWN takes precedence. A diagnostic NONPASS classifier has not been accepted.

evidence.audit: Nine inventory and nine input pins matched; no blocker in the pure decoder scope.

frameDecoder.scope: Canonical READY bindings, PID correspondence, retained byte offsets, strict UTF-8 and separate stream/frame hashes. The second frame remains opaque.
frameDecoder.limits: Chunk reconstruction does not prove native event ordering or timing. This decoder supplies no lifecycle or Clock semantic verdict.

corrections: Authenticate the exact builder-owned vector and private source before any spawn or proc effect; retain immediate-before-write hash and length checks.
Require publication time to be at least evidence end time whenever both are present, including UNKNOWN receipts.
capture.behavior: Wait for close, both stream ends, stdin callback and stdin finish. Preserve the first fault during persistence and expose a private late-fault guard. Keep historical evidence immutable while permitting the final receipt to become UNKNOWN. Anchor the one-TERM watchdog to the original start; suppress signals when clock eligibility cannot be proved.
capture.execution: Injected fake capabilities only. No native probe, process, clock, timer or host execution.
capture.reviewRework: The original candidate was rejected on two reproduced blockers. A tester assertion used reference equality for a copied receipt; the assertion was corrected, its initial result retained, and the narrow rerun passed.
capture.limits: Trusted ordinary non-Proxy inputs, non-reentrant adapters and an upstream serialized byte cap remain required. Source authentication, selected binary association, outer late-fault guard wiring, complete closure, output fit, native timing and semantic Clock acceptance remain separate gates.

next: R3C observer configuration, orchestration, memory sink and outer validation; R3D checked emission; then complete assembly, package and window closures.
